description.en: Requests an HQ event, a staged cut-scene played by the engine with the models the event has prepared: it queues a change to an "HQEvent" child scene (task Ie4HQEventTask) with the sound name, the number of cuts and the end fade. "<LG>" in the sound name is replaced by the game's language code. It plays once the calling script suspends; wait with CMND_IS_RUN_CHILD_SCENE. Use the RunHQEvent helper.
true to end on a fade to white (EndFadeWhite).

true once queued.
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.
